name: Plain Text Editor
tagline: A fast, clean Notepad-style editor that respects your file's encoding and line endings.
description: Open, edit and save plain text files the way Windows Notepad does — instantly, with zero clutter and zero lock-in. Find & replace, go-to-line, word wrap, font zoom and an F5 time/date stamp cover the essentials, while the status bar always shows your line, column, encoding and line endings. UTF-8, UTF-16 and ANSI files keep their exact encoding, BOM and CRLF/LF endings on save. Recent files, unsaved-change prompts and full keyboard shortcuts included. No rich text, no telemetry — just text.
